arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'pending' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'related',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',x.booking_id,'status',x.status,'request_id',x.request_id)) FROM bookings x WHERE x.client_reference=b.client_reference)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'capacity',capacity,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'cancel' AS kind,json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'request_id',e.request_id,'step',e.step,'booking_id',b.booking_id) AS data FROM customer_events e LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.request_id=e.request_id UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'amount',b.amount_cents) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'log',json_object('id',id,'service',service,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM request_logs WHERE message LIKE '%bkg_%' OR message LIKE '%req_%' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 35)

SELECT 'incomplete_confirmation' AS check_name,b.booking_id AS detail FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id AND i.flight_id=b.flight_id AND i.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered' AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.booking_id')=b.booking_id AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.flight_id')=b.flight_id AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.passenger_id')=b.passenger_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold',f.flight_id FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sale',client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1 UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_backed',b.booking_id FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_audit',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'cancel_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'refunds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',r.charge_id,'amount',r.amount_cents)) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config
